Kai's Run

Mobile canine conditioning service serving Destin, Fort Walton Beach, and Niceville FL. We bring a professional slatmill to your driveway for structured dog exercise sessions.

What We Do
Kai's Run provides structured slatmill conditioning sessions for high-drive dogs in the Emerald Coast area. Sessions are delivered at the client's home — no drop-off required.
Services

Intro Session: $35 (1 dog) / $55 (2 dogs) — first session, includes fitness assessment
Performance Session: $65 (1 dog) / $85 (2 dogs) — standard on-demand session
4-Session Bundle: $220 | 8-Session Bundle: $400
Monthly Membership: from $120/month (bi-weekly) to $220/month (weekly)
Founding Athlete Program: $200 for 5 sessions (limited — 20 spots)

Service Area
Destin FL, Fort Walton Beach FL, Niceville FL, Miramar Beach FL, Shalimar FL
About
Founded by Travis in Destin FL. Inspired by his Rhodesian Ridgeback mix Kai. The slatmill is a self-powered treadmill — no motor, the dog sets their own pace.
